official_definition: (When Attacks) You may target and attack an opposing Spirit. When the battling Spirit is depleted/destroyed during this battle, for every Symbol on this Spirit, send one core from the opposing Life to the Reserve, and refresh this Spirit.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Infinite Flame] or [Infinite Flame: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Infinite Flame]", "give [Infinite Flame]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
